#
Peter,
Donald Trump isn't just running our country into the ground. He's hand-picking the next generation of GOP candidates who will help him do it.
Ahead of the 2026 midterms, Trump has issued endorsements in races across the country – and the people he's backing tell you everything you need to know. These are some of the WORST of the WORST:
**🔴 VIVEK RAMASWAMY – Ohio – Governor**
Vivek Ramaswamy is an out-of-touch billionaire who has said Medicare and Medicaid were “mistakes.” During his 2024 presidential campaign, he proposed ENDING birthright citizenship. And now Trump wants to put him in the governor's mansion in Ohio – a state where working families can't afford more MAGA experiments.
**🔴 MICHAEL WHATLEY – North Carolina – U.S. Senate**
Michael Whatley isn't just endorsed by Donald Trump – he was personally recruited by him. As RNC Chairman, he spread false claims about Democratic cities engaging in “massive fraud.” He spent years as a lobbyist for Big Oil companies. And now he’s hoping to buy North Carolina’s open U.S. Senate seat in what will be one of the most expensive + competitive races of the cycle.
**🔴 MIKE ROGERS – Michigan – U.S. Senate**
Mike Rogers has a long record of voting to cut Medicare, gut the Affordable Care Act, and block commonsense gun safety legislation – even after a school shooting in his own district. He accepted over $1 MILLION from the pharmaceutical industry and then fought to keep drug companies from having to negotiate lower prices for seniors. Trump proudly endorsed him anyway.
**🔴 BURT JONES – Georgia – Governor**
Burt Jones isn't just a Trump loyalist – he's one of the most brazen election deniers in the country. In December 2020, Jones was one of 16 Georgia Republicans who signed a false certificate declaring Trump the winner of the state in a scheme to overturn the Electoral College results. Now Trump has given him his “Complete and Total Endorsement.”
**The pattern here isn't an accident. Trump is endorsing candidates that will rubber-stamp his agenda, no matter who gets hurt.**
We can stop it. But only with your help, Peter.

clean_body: Anyone who’s read the news this month can probably infer that Republicans are in serious trouble Anyone who’s read the news this month can probably infer that Republicans are in serious trouble | | | | | Fellow American, 🚨 OUR FUNDRAISING HAS HIT A SNAG 🚨 Can you spare $32, Fellow American? That 's our average donation in March so far -- and it's exactly what it will take to help us stay competitive and keep Texas red. Our fundraising has fallen off, and honestly, it's happening at a TERRIBLE time. We're preparing to report our 1st quarter fundraising numbers to the FEC, and we can't leave a single penny on the table. By now, you've probably heard: Republicans are in serious trouble here in Texas. Earlier this month, Democrats turned out in massive numbers, more than Republicans for the first time in recent memory, with over 2.3 million casting ballots in their Senate primary. Radical James Talarico emerged as their nominee, fresh off raising millions in record time, and national Democrats are already pouring in cash to make him competitive and flip the Lone Star State blue. They want to erase everything we've built here and end our 32-year winning streak for the first time since 1994. We cannot let that happen. So far this month, 430 conservatives have chipped in, averaging $32 each. It's not going to be enough to help us finish out the first quarter. That's why I'm imploring you to help me today. If we don't remain competitive, it could be the end of the line for Republicans in Texas. Can you make a $32 contribution right now? It would mean so much to us. Fellow American, I don't want to fight alone. If it's been a while since you've donated, I understand. But if you still believe in what we've fought for -- secure borders, tax relief, strong judges, and keeping Texas red -- I'm asking you to show up today. Your $32 will enable me to keep fighting for Texas values while pushing back against the radical left. Your name on our donor list shows we're not fighting alone. Thousands of grassroots donors pledging our average March donation sends a powerful message:__Conservative Republicans are energized and unshaken -- and we will not let our streak end. I'm in this fight to keep Texas red and bring common sense back to Washington. Please stand with me in this critical moment. Thank you, Ted Cruz U.S. Senator (R-TX) | | | Paid for by Ted Cruz for Senate | | PO Box 25400 Houston, TX 77265 | | | |

Hi there,
After serving our country for 35 years in the Navy, I was removed from my position by Pete Hegseth without reason.
I spent my entire life in service to this country, always putting the mission and the people above myself. But when I was forced out, I had a choice: go out quietly, or find a way to keep serving.
I’ve always lived by three simple ideals: honor, integrity, and respect. That’s why I’m running for Congress in South Carolina’s first district. If you believe that’s what we need in Washington right now, please consider splitting $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
BECOME A FOUNDING DONOR TO MY CAMPAIGN TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rrr-lacore]
The day I was removed from my position, I was forced to leave behind my life’s work. I never went back to the Pentagon or wore the uniform again.
But this story isn’t just about me. Throughout the first year of Donald Trump’s second term, every woman serving as a three or four-star admiral in the Navy has been fired, forced out, or reassigned. This wasn’t an isolated incident. It’s a pattern.
When leadership decisions are driven by politics instead of integrity, our families, communities, and nation pay the price.
That’s why I’m running for Congress: to keep serving, to stand up when it’s hardest, and to fight for leadership that puts country over politics every time.
Early support in races like this matters most. We have a long road ahead of us if we’re going to fill this open seat and make the government work for the people again. If you can, please split $20 between my campaign and Resist Reclaim Rebuild to help me hit the ground running and prove that service to our country shouldn’t end just because someone in power says it should. name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn’t the plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
Team, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution.
Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him.
But then I see millions of people meeting this moment with the courage and resolve it demands of them. People like my friend Chris Pappas. It makes me hopeful, sure. But more than that, it makes me incredibly proud.
We’re ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:
**[Split a donation between me and Chris Pappas. $5 or anything you can afford. This is an official FEC deadline month, and it’s critical that we hit our goals.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260328_2.VxTKqq&refcode=em20260328-2&t=1&akid=5807%2E582294%2Ejp-gb8)**

* Speak up for the people whose health care costs skyrocketed because the federal government decided to slash health care benefits and give the rich a tax break instead
* Defend the values we share — respect for our democracy, the importance of the rule of law, the right to bodily autonomy, and more — no matter who is attacking them
* Prioritize finding real solutions to the challenges facing communities across the country by investing in public education, working to lower housing costs and stopping the ridiculous trade wars that are driving up prices at the grocery store

Peter,

January 6th was 5 years ago...

...but for many J6 prisoners, _**their nightmare is still ongoing.**_

Despite receiving a pardon from President Trump, these **unjustly jailed men and women are still struggling to rebuild their lives** after 4 years behind bars.

Like Damon Beckley.

After four years as a political prisoner, **Damon came home to a life that had been completely destroyed.**

His family's landlord evicted them from their home, forcing his wife and son to live in an apartment with no heat. And Damon's health collapsed in prison after contracting MRSA and later requiring emergency cancer surgery.

To make matters worse, **Damon, his wife, and their son are now facing eviction and possible homelessness again.**

Like I said, Peter... Damon's story is all too common.

We recently received a request from **Kirstyn Niemela, who spent months living in a camper** in a friend's backyard during the freezing New Hampshire winter.

Because of the stigma of being labeled a J6er, **she has struggled to find stable employment.**

Now, with odd jobs having dried up during the winter months, she's at risk of losing the truck she depends on for transportation and work.

Then there's **Benjamen Burlew, who is now two months behind on his mortgage and electric bill after health issues** wiped out the family's savings.

If they fall any further behind, _**they could lose the home their children have lived in for 17 years.**_

Five years ago, Damon, Kirstyn, and Benjamen were no different than you or me.

They had steady jobs. Loving families. Homes they were proud of. And they believed in President Trump's vision for this nation.

But **the Far-Left turned them into political prisoners ... because _they couldn 't jail all of us._**

Now these patriots are trying to rebuild their lives from nothing... and many of them simply can't do it alone.

Stand in the Gap is their lifeline.

clean_body: Peter, January 6th was 5 years ago... ...but for many J6 prisoners, their nightmare is still ongoing. Despite receiving a pardon from President Trump, these unjustly jailed men and women are still struggling to rebuild their lives after 4 years behind bars. Like Damon Beckley. After four years as a political prisoner, Damon came home to a life that had been completely destroyed. His family's landlord evicted them from their home, forcing his wife and son to live in an apartment with no heat. And Damon's health collapsed in prison after contracting MRSA and later requiring emergency cancer surgery. To make matters worse, Damon, his wife, and their son are now facing eviction and possible homelessness again. Sadly, Damon's story is far too common among J6 prisoners. In just the last 60 days, for help from January 6 families struggling to survive. Unless we can count on your help, we 'll be forced to TURN AWAY some of these desperate families. Like I said, Peter... Damon's story is all too common. We recently received a request from Kirstyn Niemela, who spent months living in a camper in a friend's backyard during the freezing New Hampshire winter. Because of the stigma of being labeled a J6er, she has struggled to find stable employment. Now, with odd jobs having dried up during the winter months, she's at risk of losing the truck she depends on for transportation and work. Then there's Benjamen Burlew, who is now two months behind on his mortgage and electric bill after health issues wiped out the family's savings. If they fall any further behind, they could lose the home their children have lived in for 17 years. Five years ago, Damon, Kirstyn, and Benjamen were no different than you or me. They had steady jobs. Loving families. Homes they were proud of. And they believed in President Trump's vision for this nation. But the Far-Left turned them into political prisoners ... because they couldn 't jail all of us. Now these patriots are trying to rebuild their lives from nothing... and many of them simply can't do it alone. Stand in the Gap is their lifeline. That's why Stand in the Gap exists: to provide emergency financial aid, housing assistance, legal support, and medical help to the men and women who sacrificed everything. But we can only respond to these urgent requests with support from patriots like you, Peter. Your support helps provide: Emergency financial aid to prevent homelessness Legal defense funds for ongoing civil lawsuits Medical support for J6ers suffering lasting health problems Basic living expenses while families rebuild their lives January 6th is NOT ancient history, Peter. For these families, it's a nightmare they're still trying to escape. Without our urgent help, many of them will NOT survive to the next chapter. Stand in the Gap is their LAST lifeline... and that lifeline exists SOLELY because of generous supporters like you. Issues regarding our climate, our local economy, and high-speed internet weren't being addressed in the way that people wanted.
Which is why when I was first elected, I made it a priority to have an impact on policy that our communities felt on the ground.
Now, the same thing is happening in Congress. Politicians are complacent, be it because it's what their corporate donors want or because they're too enveloped in their toxic politics to get up and fight.
Friend, this race will determine the direction of our party and whether we elect a fighter who is ready to meet this moment or not.
Because it isn't enough to just elect Democrats, we need progressives that won't back down in office.
That's why the stakes of this race are so high and why I'm asking for your help before our deadline.
Will you help us raise the $9,449 we need to reach our goal and help me fight to deliver real results for our communities in Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20260328_em_fr_b1_HH_standard]

Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

name: Mary Peltola
subject: Sarah Palin
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
Peter, do you remember when I first ran for Congress in 2022?

I defied the odds by winning a statewide race against our former governor
Sarah Palin not only once, but twice.

My victory showed that when grassroots power works together, we can take
on the biggest challenges.

But here’s the truth about Sarah Palin:

You may not expect it, but we actually agree on a few things. We both
believe that our representatives should work to lower costs and create
jobs.

That may not seem like such a novel idea, but as you read this, DC
politicians are more focused on party loyalty and their own wallets than
getting things done for working families.

That’s why I decided to jump in this race for U.S. Senate. I’m running to
take on the rigged system that’s hurting us all, but I can’t do it without
your support.

Just like in 2022, it’s going to take a huge grassroots team to stand up
to the DC establishment and win this race.

We have our first big FEC deadline coming up, and with it our first public
report of how much support my campaign has. That’s why we need lots and
lots of donations before then to demonstrate that we have what it takes to
win.

If everyone reading this chipped in $10, we’d have what we need to hit our
fundraising goals and take on the self-serving DC system in no time.

Not everyone can, so I’m counting on those of you who understand how
important your support is before this deadline to give today.

So please, Peter:

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40440?t=1007&amount=10&akid=3504%2E52803%2EP9jZ-c ]Split a $10 contribution — or whatever you can afford today — between
Senator Angela Alsobrooks and my campaign for U.S. Senate in Alaska. The
amount isn’t as important as the donation itself. It all adds up when lots
of us are chipping in.

Thank you for everything,

Mary Peltola

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/89?t=1001&akid=3504%2E52803%2EP9jZ-c ][IMG]

An important update from Team Alsobrooks:

Angela is so thankful for this grassroots team’s support and is eager to
get to work for Marylanders in the Senate. That’s why you’ll be receiving
fewer fundraising emails from us moving forward, in an effort to not clog
up your inbox for the next six years.

Instead, we’d rather send you emails you want to read – like updates on
Angela’s work in the Senate, or rundowns of key issues and news stories
from Washington.

But to make this possible, we’re relying on supporters like you to
consider making a small, monthly recurring contribution of $3 or even $5
to keep our operations running while Angela is busy fighting for Maryland
families.

We believe that emails are the best way for our organization to stay in
touch with supporters like you. But if you'd like to receive fewer emails,

body:
I count on grassroots supporters like you to keep me competitive in this race.
Dear Peter,
Grassroots supporters like you are what power this campaign, and I want to say thank you.
I’ll be calling a few people who donate any amount through this email. Chip in any amount through this link today for a chance to get added to my call list!
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20260328_1_ak?personal=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260328_1_ak._1fuM_&refcode=em20260328-41042&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=41042%2E3422442%2Ei5F6rH)**
I’m running for governor against candidates with massive financial resources.
One of them is a billionaire self-funding his campaign to the tune of _$101 million_. Others are cashing huge corporate checks and will do their bidding if they win.
I don’t run my campaign that way. I’m a working single mom who doesn’t have millions to spend. And I’ve never taken corporate money because I fight for the people, not corporations.
**I count on grassroots supporters like you chipping in to my campaign instead.** And so far, you’ve helped keep me competitive in this race.

That’s why I’m calling grassroots supporters personally to say thank you for standing with my campaign. Chip in any amount through this link today and you just might get a call from me.

That’s why I’m calling grassroots supporters personally to say thank you for standing with my campaign. Chip in any amount through this link today and you just might get a call from me. Thank you so much for your support, Katie P.S. Keep your ringers on and look out for an Irvine area code!

name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn’t the plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260328-2.IAODsZ&amount=5&%3Brefcode=em20260328-3025&t=1&akid=3025%2E21716%2EGrdvux)
When Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution.
Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him.
But then I see millions of people meeting this moment with the courage and resolve it demands of them. People like my friend Congresswoman Sarah McBride. It makes me hopeful, sure. But more than that, it makes me incredibly proud.
We’re ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:
[**Split a donation between me and Sarah McBride. $5 or anything you can afford. This is an official FEC deadline month, and it’s critical that we hit our goals.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260328-2.IAODsZ&refcode=em20260328-3025&amount=5&t=2&akid=3025%2E21716%2EGrdvux)

Mark

# [Make Voting Easier, Not Harder. Tell Republicans to Keep Their Damn Hands Off Your Voting Rights](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb4f94275-6a48-44f4-921a-6efc2df264ef/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | This is pretty straightforward:
* Voting is a right
* You don't get to put impediments in the way of a right
* If you don't like that, tough shit.
* If Republicans think people should have to spend a bunch of time and money to get all kinds of paperwork for no reason before they can vote, they can go f*** themselves.
* Let's require Republicans to get prostate exams when they vote. With a turkey leg. For freedom (if that's how you wanna play, game on).

We need to make voting easier for people, with voting by mail, same-day registration (or none), and whatever else lets voters cast their ballots more easily. It's not a goddamn obstacle course, it's people exercising their rights. **[Add your name, and demand that voting be made easier, not harder. And tell Republicans to keep their damn hands off your voting rights](https://default.salsalabs.org/T30588c3f-7415-429a-9ee2-04e87da3c968/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9).**

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul “Bear” Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

Dan has doubled his net worth since taking office thanks to his stock portfolio, which somehow performed even better than Warren Buffett's. 2. Dan voted to kick 30,000 of his own constituents off their health insurance and rip food assistance away from struggling families so that billionaires could get another tax break. 3. Dan took a luxury vacation to Mar-a-Lago last weekend where he used his insider status not to advocate for his constituents, but to host a two-day high-dollar fundraiser for his campaign. That's what we're up against in this race. I'm not running to get rich. I'm running because our part of Pennsylvania is my home, and the people here deserve someone who fights for us. If you can, it would mean a lot to me if you'd Every dollar helps us build a campaign strong enough to take on Meuser's war chest and kick him out of Congress. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | Hi, This is Brigadier General James Emory Mace, U.S. Army (Retired). Today, I write to you not as a soldier... but as a father. I’m a Vietnam War Veteran and Purple Heart Medal recipient. I’ve worn the uniform. I’ve buried friends who never made it home. And I’ve felt the sting of a Nation that sometimes forgets what our sacrifices were for. But my daughter - Congresswoman Nancy Mace - never forgot. Nancy was raised in the shadow of the flag. She saw the uniform. She lived with the deployments. She knew the cost. And instead of running from it, she ran toward it. That’s the kind of person -the kind of fighter \- she is. When Nancy was 17, she dropped out of high school. Most kids in that situation fall apart. But not Nancy. I raised her to believe that setbacks don’t define you -how you rise does. She grew up hearing the same lessons over and over again: 👉 Never quit. 👉 Never run from the truth.👉 And never let anyone tell you thatyou are less than what God made you to be. So I gave her a choice: She picked herself up, took a job at Waffle House, and fought her way back. By 21, she became the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, following in my footsteps. Soon after, she was elected as the first woman to represent South Carolina in the U.S. House of Representatives. She’s been fighting her whole life; for herself, for her kids, for the truth, and now...for her state. Nancy led an evacuation mission in the Middle East after learning a South Carolina family was stranded. Because when your people are stuck in a war zone getting hit with missiles and rockets, the only answer worthy of the office -worthy of our country \- is to get them out. She flew into an active war zone and answered the call when Americans needed help. As a father - and as a Purple Heart Veteran \- I’ve never been more proud of my daughter. That’s why it’s hard when I have to watch Nancy face relentless attacks day after day. Each day that goes out there and fights for you, she’s up against the Establishment’s knife. They stalk her. Send her death threats. She’s even been physically assaulted. But Nancy is my daughter. And I know this: She never backs down. And she never stops fighting. I want to ask you something from one parent, one patriot, to another: Will you support my daughter in the toughest battle of her life? But even in the face of all that, Nancy stood up for me. 👉 She stood up for EVERY veteran who was forgotten. 👉 She stood up for stranded American families and rescued them from an active Middle East warzone.👉 She stood up when other Republicans stayed silent. And now, she’s standing up for YOU. But she needs your backup. I may not wear the uniform anymore, but I still believe in answering the call. Will you answer it with me today? Nancy’s not running to make friends. She’s running to win. To fight. To serve. That’s what she learned growing up in our home. That’s what she learned watching me go off to war. And that’s what she’ll carry with her to the Governor’s Mansion. May God bless you and your family. With respect, General James Emory Mace (Ret.) Proud Father of Nancy Mace | | | | | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter. Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained. At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts. By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks. She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history. Nancy is fighting to: Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front. South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started. | | | | | | | | Paid for by Nancy Mace For Governor | | Copyright © 2025 , All rights reserved.

I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128269215/610783506/1810842639?refcode=AU_MTH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20260328_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS84OTA0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNjJiZjhjMi1lMDJhLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mUVrYKDW27ybQRSdcG0cnwCDQGkJSPYRxD3zjk4HTTk=) Team, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life. But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy. I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution. Jason Crow For Colorado [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP21/1/88523/images/Screenshot%202025-08-21%20at%2010.50.41%E2%80%AFAM.png]
Hi there, serving in the United States Army was one of the greatest honors of my life. I’ve never forgotten the creed I lived by when I served as an Army Ranger:

“My country expects me to move further, faster, and fight harder than any other.”
“I will shoulder more than my share of the task, whatever it may be, 100% and then some.”
“Under no circumstances will I ever embarrass my country.”

After 9/11, I served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan.

My three tours taught me a lot about respect, working under pressure, and the value of selfless service to others.

As a leader, it was on me to set an example — to be the last one to eat, and the first one to jump out of the plane.

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-mar26?amount=10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-mar26?amount=10]In Congress, I work every day to be a true servant leader for my constituents. But the leadership we’re seeing at the very top right now is the exact opposite.

Donald Trump doesn't care about the promises he's made to the American people. He makes it more and more clear every day he’s in the White House.

But I care about the Creed I lived by as an Army Ranger, and I care about the oath I took to our Constitution when I was sworn into Congress.

I joined the military to protect our rights and freedoms. I ran for office to make a difference in people’s lives. We need more leaders who are ready to do the hard work and bring people together.

But I can’t do this alone. Hi Peter, Deb Haaland here.
Happy Women’s History Month. I’m thinking about my great-grandmother, my mother, and the generations of women who came before me.
My mom was born in a train boxcar where the Laguna people built a community far from home. She served in the U.S. Navy, raised four kids as a military wife, and spent more than two decades in Indian education. **I come from generations of resilient, fierce Pueblo women. They taught me to Be Fierce — to protect our communities and never back down.**
That’s why I ran for office. Standing on their shoulders, I became one of the first Native women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet secretary — and the whole time, I never stopped being fierce.
I’ve stood up to corporate polluters. I rebuilt the Department of the Interior after Trump slashed staff, cut budgets, and rolled back protections. I defended our public lands and our people when they were under attack.
And I won’t stop now.
**But I can’t do this alone.[Will you split a donation of $5 or whatever you can today between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to help me keep fighting for New Mexico?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102027?refcode=em20260328-10237&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=5&t=2&akid=10237%2E614464%2ElEnSkg)**

Peter, right now Trump and his allies are doing everything they can to tear us down — gutting health care, raising costs, ignoring the affordability crisis, attacking reproductive freedom, dismantling voting rights, and sowing fear in our communities to hold onto power.
But I won’t back down.
I was a single mom. I relied on Medicaid, WIC, and SNAP. I worked multiple jobs and started a small salsa business to get by. I know what it means to keep fighting — even when it feels like things aren’t getting any easier.
That’s why I’m prepared to lead.
I understand affordability because I’ve lived it. I know how critical strong public schools, accessible health care, and safe communities are — because my family relied on them.
And I’ve led at the highest levels of government — in Congress and as U.S. Secretary of the Interior — where I took on tough fights and delivered real results.
Experience matters. Leadership matters. And I’m ready.
But there are Republicans ready to spend whatever it takes to bring Trump’s extreme agenda to New Mexico — and we can’t let that happen.

Standing on their shoulders, I became one of the first Native women elected to Congress and then the first Native American Cabinet secretary — and the whole time, I never stopped being fierce. I’ve stood up to corporate polluters. I rebuilt the Department of the Interior after Trump slashed staff, cut budgets, and rolled back protections. I defended our public lands and our people when they were under attack. And I won’t stop now. But I can’t do this alone. Peter, right now Trump and his allies are doing everything they can to tear us down — gutting health care, raising costs, ignoring the affordability crisis, attacking reproductive freedom, dismantling voting rights, and sowing fear in our communities to hold onto power. But I won’t back down. I was a single mom. I relied on Medicaid, WIC, and SNAP. I worked multiple jobs and started a small salsa business to get by. I know what it means to keep fighting — even when it feels like things aren’t getting any easier. That’s why I’m prepared to lead. I understand affordability because I’ve lived it. I know how critical strong public schools, accessible health care, and safe communities are — because my family relied on them. And I’ve led at the highest levels of government — in Congress and as U.S. Secretary of the Interior — where I took on tough fights and delivered real results. Experience matters. Leadership matters. And I’m ready. But there are Republicans ready to spend whatever it takes to bring Trump’s extreme agenda to New Mexico — and we can’t let that happen. So I’m asking again: If you have stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Deb Haaland and Heartland Patriots will process instantly: We won’t back down. We’ll Be Fierce. 💛 Deb | | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce.com). Not authorized by any federal candidate or candidate committee.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

This week, Brad shared his story in an op-ed published by the Cobb County Courier. Below are highlights or you can read the entire piece [**HERE**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=5b86a104e2&e=6036811227).

[**Cobb Currier: Making Georgia Affordable, Safe, and Strong for Every Family**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=087241975a&e=6036811227)
_Recently, I had the opportunity to spend time in Cobb County meeting with community leaders and local families. The conversations were honest and direct. People are proud of their communities, but they’re also concerned about the future._
_Two primary issues came up again and again:**affordability and safety**._
_As a Christian, conservative businessman who built companies and created jobs before entering public service, I’ve always believed government should focus on practical solutions that help families thrive._
_Across Georgia, families are making difficult choices. Some are picking up extra shifts. Others are working second jobs just to make ends meet. That isn’t sustainable, and it’s not the Georgia we want to leave to the next generation._
_As a candidate for governor, I’ve made it a priority not just to talk about these challenges, but to put forward serious, workable plans to address them._
_One of the most urgent issues we must_[ _**tackle is property taxes**_](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=399a2c8932&e=6036811227) _. For many homeowners—especially seniors on fixed incomes—rising property taxes are becoming a heavy burden. I’ve proposed a comprehensive property tax relief plan that would cap property taxes for all Georgians and fully eliminate non-public safety, non-education property taxes for seniors. If you’ve spent a lifetime working hard and paying into your community, you shouldn’t have to worry about being taxed out of your own home._
_Of course, one of the best ways to address the affordability crisis is through opportunity. When people have access to good-paying jobs, communities grow stronger and families gain the stability they need to build better future._
_That’s why I’ve released a_[ _**jobs plan focused on creating high-quality opportunities across every region of Georgia**_](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=07f0ff5665&e=6036811227) _. The plan builds on our state’s existing economic development strengths and uses targeted, performance-based incentives to attract reshored jobs in strategic, high-growth industries. By bringing these jobs back to American soil—and into Georgia communities—we can strengthen our economy while ensuring hardworking Georgians share in that prosperity._
_Georgia is already the greatest state in our nation, but we can’t stay that way without planning for the future. With the right leadership and the right priorities, we can make it even stronger—safer neighborhoods, a more affordable cost of living, and greater opportunity for every family._
_That’s the Georgia I’m fighting for._

Read the entire op-ed [**HERE**](https://BradForGeorgia.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb0b5d8f4cac8238170f7992f&id=21424e4e67&e=6036811227).

The conversations were honest and direct. People are proud of their communities, but they’re also concerned about the future. Two primary issues came up again and again:affordability and safety. As a Christian, conservative businessman who built companies and created jobs before entering public service, I’ve always believed government should focus on practical solutions that help families thrive. Across Georgia, families are making difficult choices. Some are picking up extra shifts. Others are working second jobs just to make ends meet. That isn’t sustainable, and it’s not the Georgia we want to leave to the next generation. As a candidate for governor, I’ve made it a priority not just to talk about these challenges, but to put forward serious, workable plans to address them. One of the most urgent issues we must . For many homeowners—especially seniors on fixed incomes—rising property taxes are becoming a heavy burden. I’ve proposed a comprehensive property tax relief plan that would cap property taxes for all Georgians and fully eliminate non-public safety, non-education property taxes for seniors. If you’ve spent a lifetime working hard and paying into your community, you shouldn’t have to worry about being taxed out of your own home. Of course, one of the best ways to address the affordability crisis is through opportunity. When people have access to good-paying jobs, communities grow stronger and families gain the stability they need to build better future. That’s why I’ve released a . The plan builds on our state’s existing economic development strengths and uses targeted, performance-based incentives to attract reshored jobs in strategic, high-growth industries. By bringing these jobs back to American soil—and into Georgia communities—we can strengthen our economy while ensuring hardworking Georgians share in that prosperity. Georgia is already the greatest state in our nation, but we can’t stay that way without planning for the future. With the right leadership and the right priorities, we can make it even stronger—safer neighborhoods, a more affordable cost of living, and greater opportunity for every family. That’s the Georgia I’m fighting for. Read the entire op-ed . | | | Brad has been on the road meeting with Georgians across the state, engaging directly with professionals, community leaders, and local business owners about the issues that matter most. From speaking with the Licensed Professional Counselors Association at the Capitol to sharing his vision with the Peachtree City Rotary, leaders from Georgia’s Korean community, the Atlanta West End Rotary, and meeting with business leaders in Paulding County, these conversations have focused on strengthening Georgia’s workforce, supporting economic growth, and keeping communities safe. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Join Team Raff | | Brad is setting a clear course for Georgia’s future backed by integrity and family values. But turning that vision into results takes more than one person. It takes a team. If you believe Georgia should remain the No. 1 state to live, work, and do business, now is the time to step up. Join Team Raff today to support our grassroots efforts, help deliver real results for hardworking families, and be part of the movement building a stronger, more affordable, and safer Georgia. Look, I know campaign finance talk is boring.
Every campaign out there is writing to you about the Federal Election Commission deadline. I know you're probably sick of hearing about it.
But this is the most important deadline of our campaign, and when the clock strikes midnight on March 31st, there's no going back.
Everyone from my primary opponents to MAGA mega-donors to Donald Trump himself will be taking a close look at our numbers to see if we have the strength to win this race in Maryland's 5th District and take back the House majority. **If we don 't hit our fundraising milestones, they will see our campaign as weak and flood this race with MILLIONS to undermine us.**
**We can 't let that happen.**
How much we raise is important -- but how many people contribute is just as big a deal. Already, we've shown how strong our movement is thanks to the support of tens of thousands of individual donors. On average, everyday folks are pitching in $18.81 to our campaign, while my opponents are raking in massive checks. _One even has an average donation of $612._
That's not how I operate. I can't self-fund this campaign, and I wouldn't want to if I could. I'm not ultra-wealthy. I'm a girl dad, a football lover, and a former Capitol Police Officer who is ready to fight like hell to defend our democracy.
#### **[If you're ready to send a fighter who isn't afraid to stand up to Donald Trump, will you donate today to help me hit my 105,000 FEC donor goal? Let's make sure we have a strong showing and prove to everyone we have what it takes to win here in Maryland and flip the House.](https://substack.com/redirect/bd0e2e1a-4494-4002-812f-51c9b2598bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[LET'S WIN THIS](https://substack.com/redirect/bd0e2e1a-4494-4002-812f-51c9b2598bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Reporting strong numbers could make all the difference between a Democrat-held House... or Donald Trump continuing his rampage without accountability.
We can't afford more of the same when Trump and his MAGA enablers are defiling the Constitution and eroding our democracy.
Many of these same Republicans were evacuated to safety on January 6th while my fellow Capitol Police officers and I fought to protect them.
We put our bodies on the line. We were beaten, pepper-sprayed, brutalized, all to give them time to escape.
Now they're rewriting history. They're calling the insurrectionists "patriots." They're claiming January 6th was just a "normal tourist visit." **And an insurrectionist who called on his fellow rioters to "kill" officers like me is now shaping policy in the Department of Justice.**
This isn't normal and it can't continue. We have the opportunity to hold Trump and his enablers accountable in the House, but only if we win races like mine. And we can only win this race if everyday folks like you step up right now.
#### **[Please help us file a strong fundraising report that leaves no doubt that we have the momentum to win. Donate before midnight to help me get across the finish line:](https://substack.com/redirect/bd0e2e1a-4494-4002-812f-51c9b2598bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ KEEP UP THE MOMENTUM](https://substack.com/redirect/bd0e2e1a-4494-4002-812f-51c9b2598bd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you,
Harry

body:
#

Hi Peter —
[**I’m writing to ask, humbly, if you will chip in $25 to my reelection campaign ahead of our important FEC fundraising deadline this Tuesday.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em250328-2-f&t=1&akid=1962%2E5691347%2EGT1uDk)
Here’s why this request is so important, especially today:
The end of this month marks the most important fundraising deadline we’ve faced so far in our campaign, and one of the most critical tests of the movement we’ve built in Georgia.
After the deadline, we’re legally required to report our fundraising numbers to the Federal Election Commission — and shortly after, those numbers will be made public.
Everyone from Donald Trump to my Republican opponents and their billionaire allies are going to look at our fundraising numbers closely. Very closely.
If they think we look weak, you can bet they’ll flood the airwaves with even more attack ads designed to distort my record. Attacks we can’t afford this early in the campaign.
We have to show everyone that our movement in Georgia is thriving and unstoppable — that we have what it takes to build the strongest voter outreach and mobilization program our state has ever seen. Because that’s what it’s going to take to win this race.
That’s why I’m personally asking:
[**Will you make a contribution to my campaign before our critical FEC deadline Tuesday night? Every donation counts. Each one sends a powerful message that people like you have my back.**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-mar26.B6mAX1&refcode=em250328-2-f&t=2&akid=1962%2E5691347%2EGT1uDk)

Thank you for everything.
Jon

**I just got off the stage at the No Kings Rally in Minnesota.** The energy out here is palpable. I’ve spent my life using my voice to stand up for what’s right, and right now, it's impossible to ignore what's happening in this country. Whether it's militarized ICE operations terrorizing communities across the Twin Cities, or the dismantlement of our First Amendment rights with books being banned, journalists silenced, museums and arts councils defunded — _we are watching authoritarianism unfold in real time._ **The actions we take in moments like these define what kind of country we choose to be. And they demand leaders who refuse to sit on the sidelines while Trump consolidates power.** **[That’s why my Climate PAC is proud to endorse Peggy Flanagan for U.S. Senate in Minnesota. Peggy is exactly the kind of leader I had in mind when I launched the Jane Fonda Climate PAC. She even joined me on stage today to say Minnesota doesn’t do kings!
While too many politicians look the other way as ICE agents terrorize our neighbors, Peggy shows up. She’s traveled across the state, protested alongside community members, and stood with parents and teachers to demand ICE stay out of schools.
She knows that Minnesotans are resilient. They take care of one another, and that when things get tough, they face it _together._ It's the same courage she's brought to another fight: taking on the fossil fuel industry that's been poisoning our air and water while buying off politicians.
As Lieutenant Governor, Peggy helped make Minnesota one of the first states to require 100% carbon-free energy by 2040. She secured over $1 billion for climate resilience and clean energy. She publicly opposed the Line 3 pipeline. And she's rejected fossil fuel money her entire career.
But I want to be clear: Peggy’s race isn’t an easy win. She’s up against an opponent that has raised over $4 million, with coffers filled to the brim with special interest money from insurance companies, Big Pharma, banks, and the energy industry. **There's even a PAC funded by Chevron that spent over $600,000 on digital ads to boost her opponent’s campaign.**
Big Oil knows exactly what's at stake. They're terrified of leaders like Peggy who can't be bought.
And that’s why your grassroots support today could not be more necessary. We not only have a real opportunity to send a true fighter to the U.S. Senate, but if elected, **Peggy will be the first Native American woman ever to serve in the U.S. Senate.**
Now that’s something worth fighting for.

name: Andy Kim
subject: Nellie Pou is one of New Jersey’s strongest voices in Congress
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nellie Pou for Congress Nellie Pou for Congress
body:
Nellie has spent her career standing up for working families.

| |
---

Hi. It's Michele.
Sports have always been a part of my DNA. I grew up watching football on the weekends with my father. My husband played baseball at the University of Minnesota. And I've covered more games than I could count.
I remember when Title IX was passed, my mother told my three sisters and me that we'd have opportunities she and her mother never had. We could join more teams and compete at the highest level.
I wouldn't have been able to make it in the sports world without it.
That's why it ENRAGES me to no end watching the far-Left make a mockery of women's sports...

* Allowing men to compete against women...
* Stealing scholarships and awards from women...
* Putting young girls in harm's way...
* Forcing girls to share locker rooms with boys...
* Retaliating against girls who object...

clean_body: I grew up watching football on the weekends with my father. My husband played baseball at the University of Minnesota. | Hi. It's Michele. Sports have always been a part of my DNA. I grew up watching football on the weekends with my father. My husband played baseball at the University of Minnesota. And I've covered more games than I could count. I remember when Title IX was passed, my mother told my three sisters and me that we'd have opportunities she and her mother never had. We could join more teams and compete at the highest level. I wouldn't have been able to make it in the sports world without it. That's why it ENRAGES me to no end watching the far-Left make a mockery of women's sports... Allowing men to compete against women... Stealing scholarships and awards from women... Putting young girls in harm's way... Forcing girls to share locker rooms with boys... Retaliating against girls who object... If you think this is the right thing to do, it says a LOT more about you than it does about the rest of the country. The far-Left and the activist mob have made this issue a litmus test for their side. If you disagree with any of those bullet points, they'll come after you. And that's exactly what's happening as you're reading this. My opponents and the far-Left propaganda machine are hammering me with attack ads, on social media, and in the press - anything to destroy my candidacy. We're struggling to get our message out to voters because the career politicians running against me have a deep network of mega-donors lining up to defeat me. That's where you can make a real difference in one of the biggest Senate races in the country. ** I'm respectfully asking everyone on this list to pitch in something. But that's why it's so important for those who understand the gravity of the midterm elections to step up. We're up against a powerful group of career politicians, extreme activists, and partisan media operatives. It's not easy to reach every voter to correct the record. We'll need an army of regular people joining our campaign to defeat them. You are a big part of that effort. Thanks in advance for your support! Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele Tafoya Republican for Senate, Minnesota I'll cut to the chase because I'll never be one of those career politicians who are asking you for money when they don't urgently need it. After the 2026 elections are over, we might be able to look back on this past week as a glaring warning of what was to come.
In what Donald Trump’s former Chief Strategist Steve Bannon suggests could be a “test run” for the midterms, Trump has deployed ICE agents to airports — where his refusal to fund the TSA has led to severe screening delays, with lines stretching out the door.
**Bannon already said “we’re gonna have ICE surround the polls come November.”** Now we see Trump using this paramilitary force in the middle of his funding standoff with Democrats in Congress, who insist upon basic accountability measures for ICE agents.
Of course, ICE doesn’t have any business in monitoring polling places. And the federal government does not have the authority to manage elections.
But Trump has made no secret of his desire for Republicans to “take over” the voting process. **And even the threat of sending ICE agents to the polls — who could intimidate voters into staying home, or pluck people out of line for harassment based on the color of their skin — could amount to meaningful interference in our elections.**

NC Newsline: Amid protests, NC elections board rejects campus voting sites and Sunday voting in several counties [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032826_1&amount=25]
We're facing the repercussions of the partisan election takeover laws that went into effect at the end of 2024, Team.
To refresh your memory: After the 2024 elections and the defeat of a MAGA candidate for governor, opponents of voting rights in North Carolina jammed through a bill that took the power of the governor to appoint people to election boards and handed that to the state auditor . It's worth noting that the state auditor is the only statewide elected Republican, with Democrats winning the 2024 races for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, and secretary of state.
Now, among massive protests from young voters, the MAGA-fied North Carolina State Elections Board recently shot down proposals to continue having early voting sites at several universities around the state . These weren't new sites either; these were places where North Carolina had provided early voting locations for a decade or more.
This is voter suppression, plain and simple, by making it harder for eligible, registered voters to vote in-person by taking away their polling place. It's another demonstration of how opponents of voting rights in North Carolina are more focused on expanding and cementing their own power than they are in serving the people and having fair elections.
We have to fight these suppressive actions in North Carolina and any other state where opponents of voting rights try to replicate this. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today to help every eligible voter cast their ballot >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032826_1&amount=35]

These new, highly partisan State Election Board members wouldn't even look the protestors in the eye or engage with their proposals. After the vote, Chairman Francis De Luca threatened to call the cops on students if they didn’t leave.
Need to better understand how this impacts young voters? Western Carolina University in Jackson County, for example, has had a polling place on campus since 2016 that’s been used in five general elections and four primaries, according to a document prepared for the board. The state board voted 3-2 to get rid of it.
Closing the campus voting site would not save money, but “ would create barriers to voting for young, rural residents ,” Jackson County Board member Betsy Swift told the state board. 64% of students don’t have vehicles to drive to the polling place, she said.
Without the on-campus site, the closest polling place for students will be a recreation center nearly two miles away. Students without transportation will have to walk along a four-lane highway and through a meadow to get there.
Voter suppression isn't just black and white photos of eligible voters being turned away from polling places. Voter suppression is making it harder for eligible voters to take part in our elections through onerous ID requirements, closing polling places, taking away voting locations, or ending mail-in voting. Every time someone makes it harder to cast your ballot, voters are suppressed.
It's not going to end until we stop them.

[](https://substack.com/redirect/af350603-6034-4d87-8638-2eb913a19421?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Records Are Meant to Fall And Kobe Would Understand That

There's been a lot of noise around Bam Adebayo putting up 83 points and passing Kobe Bryant's iconic mark.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6e88388a-9b18-4ee5-aab0-482fb09d488e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I've seen people saying he should've checked out of the game. That it was disrespectful. That some records shouldn't be touched.

As someone who started watching basketball because of Kobe back in 1997, I completely disagree.

Records are not meant to be protected. They are meant to be chased.

That's the foundation of competition.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5bf9b604-98c4-4452-bef4-b632f93a6bc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kobe's 81 stood for 20 years. That's not something fragile. That's dominance. That's a standard that lasted across eras. But honoring that doesn't mean freezing the game in time. It means understanding how great you have to be to even get close.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.8zTEnhqRwdgL4f78kOWeWVeVkZaZG-W5t0NbBsja8MY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=192461865)
And if we're being honest about who Kobe was, the idea that he would want someone to stop scoring to protect his legacy doesn't line up at all. Kobe respected killers. He respected competitors. If anything, he would've appreciated the effort it took to even be in that position.

Now let's be real about something. Do I think this performance was better than Kobe's 81? No. Not even close.

Kobe's game came in a different era. The game was more physical. Spacing was tighter. The offense wasn't built to create easy scoring opportunities the way it is now.

Today's game is built for scoring. The defensive three-second rule opened up the lane. The floor is spaced with shooters. Bigs can handle the ball, step out, and shoot from deep. Once you beat your defender, there's often nothing standing between you and the basket.

That doesn't take anything away from Bam's 83. It just puts it into proper context.

But the real issue isn't Bam.

It's the defense.

At some point, pride has to kick in. You cannot let one player score 83 points on you. Double him. Trap him. Force the ball out of his hands. Make someone else beat you.

That's the part people should be talking about.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/08040112-edec-4999-b716-c00ad5148603?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Telling a player to sit down to preserve someone else's legacy goes against everything competition stands for. You don't honor greatness by limiting effort. You honor it by matching it.

And if the game continues to trend the way it is right now, this won't be the last time we see something like this. With the pace, spacing, and skill level across all positions, even Wilt Chamberlains 100-point record may not be untouchable forever.

Kobe's legacy was never just about 81 points. It was about mentality. Relentless. Ruthless. Unapologetically competitive.

If we really respect that, then we should respect players who go out there and chase greatness at the highest level.

Not ask them to stop when they get too close.

---
| [](http://clicksp.frostforcongress.com/f/a/PUjx3Ivb3iOxpaGwVugcIg~~/AAPPABA~/EBxJogWvvFfVVHVeWAGZgf2Xw2uvApH00XRDzTLmP7EJTwFLCKqCW5wYh4MgJ_-ktygfIR306eRGdOVrnGXhppWfv2iJ9MyybSCxUmMbf4u_fj78Ului5Vy7oCNbr6FyOZFroSlEYxAeB8qey35MJT_HcQpgGLcpDzPxLQ1D2xswtUHKEUdTtmrOsouBuzkXMgeBNW5d1gjrCtIsOUrfwBFSpl5QEkK64QQaMmXLA37mcu9BCxxIKlHZmj-z6oJt6ZUpOuPCr4Yr9uqhItRNcjt51X_hQowvuinQp-NINGLqN0mspzwC4Bq0HBT6CqilvWbHkJZKXJbkXIUMJhN9yw~~) I just got back from the No Kings Day protest in Orlando and the energy out there gave me chills.

Thousands of people showed up loud and clear: No kings. No fascists. Not here.

Before I was in Congress, I was an organizer. I know what it looks like when people are fired up and ready to fight — and today was that.

clean_body: - Michele Tafoya here! I never really considered running for office. Ever. I was too focused on raising my family, and being the best football sideline reporter I could be. But even in the last few weeks, Minnesota has become the embodiment of everything wrong with politics today. Tim Walz, his inner circle, and the corrupt political class are too busy: Wasting billions of our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares Failing to condemn the activists storming churches Raising prices on hardworking families Sabotaging anything the President wants to do Forcing men into women's spaces Pitting Americans against each other I can 't sit on the sidelines anymore. That's why I'm throwing my hat in the ring and announcing my candidacy for U.S. Senate! thought long and hard about the dynamics of this race before jumping in. Minnesota has long been considered simply out of reach for Republicans. The last time it voted for a GOP President was Nixon. The pundits and political experts say a Republican could never win here. But this year is going to be different for three key reasons: FIRST - I'm running against Tim Walz's right hand. All the rampant fraud that took place here happened under Peggy Flanagan's nose as much as it did under his. We will remind voters about that fact every single day. SECOND - The President has increased his voter share each time he has run. He nearly flipped this state in the last election, and Kamala Harris' running mate was our sitting Governor! Momentum is on our side. THIRD - I'm a different kind of candidate, and I know how to win. I didn't reach the top of my industry by pulling my punches. I put in the work. I never backed down. And I kept fighting, no matter what the naysayers said. In my years on the sidelines, I 've seen a LOT of underdogs win football games that the "experts" said were impossible. The Minnesota Senate race will be another chapter in that storied history. | | ---|--- Thanks in advance for your support. name: Katie Porter
subject: On the road
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Governor 2026
body:
California is a big state, and I want to continue hearing from every corner of it.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=41055%2E3422442%2EeaKg8v)
Peter,
I’m packing up the minivan and taking this campaign on the road!
California is a big state, and I want to continue hearing from every corner of it. **That’s why we’re kicking off our statewide Whiteboard Warriors Tour.**
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260328_2_ak.Wn9PcS&refcode=em20260328-41055&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41055%2E3422442%2EeaKg8v)
I’m running for Governor to be a voice for all Californians—not just the ones with corporate lobbyists. That’s why I’m going to all parts of California to meet voters, hear what’s most pressing to them, and earn their support.
We’re kicking off our Whiteboard Warriors Tour in the Central Valley, but we’re going to be visiting all corners of California because that’s what it will take to win.
Getting on the road and hosting town halls takes real resources. I don’t have corporate PACs who will bankroll these events because I reject every penny from them. Instead, I’m counting on supporters like you, Peter.
**[Chip in $5 to help us put gas in the minivan and take this campaign on the road. Your donation will help us reach voters and cut through the corporate PAC money flooding this race.](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_kp_20260328_2_ak.Wn9PcS&refcode=em20260328-41055&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=41055%2E3422442%2EeaKg8v)**

Thank you, and see you on the road!
Katie

name: Stacey Abrams
subject: I am in New Mexico helping my friend Deb Haaland become the next governor
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
We must fight back, friend, and the best way we can do that is by electing Democratic governors like Deb this November.

| | |
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5903?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=1&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)
Friend, Stacey Abrams here.

I wanted to personally reach out because right now I am in New Mexico helping my friend Deb Haaland become the next governor. **[Will you join me right now and chip in $5 to help her win this November?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5906?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=2&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [Donate $10 >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5914?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=3&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)
---
| | [Donate $35 >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5915?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=4&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)
---
| | [Donate $50 >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5916?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=5&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)
---
| | [Other Amount >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5903?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=6&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)
---
Today, Deb and I attended a No Kings rally here in New Mexico. People are fed up with waking up to devastating news every day. SNAP benefits are being cut. Costs are skyrocketing. ICE is tearing through communities. Voting rights are being eroded. Trump’s priorities are clear: himself and his billionaire friends, _whatever the cost._

We must fight back, friend, and the best way we can do that is by electing Democratic governors like Deb this November.
Deb and I have been friends for years – she’s a trailblazer. She’s a single mother who lived paycheck to paycheck, relied on SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to raise her child. She’s organized and mobilized Indigenous communities to vote. And she became one of the first Native women elected to Congress and the first Native Cabinet secretary in our nation’s history. **Deb’s leadership is rooted in lived experience, which is why she knows that government should work for people, not the other way around.**
That’s why Deb is the best candidate to take on Trump’s autocratic regime and fight for our democracy. She will expand healthcare, cut costs, deliver for working families, and safeguard voting rights. _New Mexico was just the first state to bar armed federal agents from polling places._ Deb is ready to start delivering on Day One.
But from now until November won’t be easy.

The governorship in New Mexico has flipped parties every eight years, and national Republicans see this as their next opportunity to install another Trump-aligned governor, which is why there are three Republican candidates in the race and millions of outside money is pouring in.
That’s why I want to make sure that Deb meets her $100,000 end-of-quarter goal, and with just days to go, she needs your help. **[Will you join me right now and chip in $5 to help power Deb to victory and keep New Mexico blue?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5906?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=7&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)**
| | [RUSH $5 NOW >>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5906?refcode=jtk472-fr-nd&t=8&akid=8563%2E400544%2El60M4o)
---
Sincere thanks,

Stacey
